Lina (Marketing): Quick check 1: new Triad Systems case study + 30s testimonial for EU launch. Need approvals (quote + logo) and lead routing to HubSpot by EOD Friday.
Marco (Growth): Promo dates: 2026-06-02 publish, boost 6/2-6/9. Need 30s org, 15s ad, 6s bumper. UTM format: utm_campaign=triad_case_eu.
Tess (CS): I have the customer's draft quote but it references a contract number and internal cluster names. Legal will need to redact or customer sign simplified release.
Ravi (Legal): We can't publish contract numbers. Recommend asking customer to initial a short release that approves quote + logo. If they refuse, we'll remove the identifiers and confirm with CS.
Lina (Marketing): Tess please send the simplified release. Also we need localization for FR and DE subs (burned). Lower third: "Triad Systems 1: Head of ML Ops, Jonas Weber".
Tess (CS): Sent DocuSign with checkbox for logo + quote + webinar participation. ETA 12 hours. Customer replied: ok to publish but wants exact latency numbers replaced with relative wording.
Ravi (Legal): Approved phrasing: "~25% faster 99th percentile latency" instead of exact ms. Good to publish once signed.
Marco (Growth): DeployBot, create SFDC campaign skeleton and HubSpot workflow named: Triad_Case_EU_2026.
DeployBot: Draft SFDC campaign created: "Triad_Case_EU_2026". HubSpot workflow: "Triad_Case_Nurture_7d". Use /deploy finalize to activate.
Lina (Marketing): Pre-publish checklist: render master, exports (30/15/6), burn subs EN/FR/DE, CDN upload, SFDC finalize, HubSpot enable, blog (650 words), social copy + images, set embargo 2026-06-02T08:00:00Z.
Marco (Growth): I'll assign budget owner (growth@redwood.com) and set audience: EU enterprise lookalikes + webinar retargets.
Tess (CS): Customer signed the DocuSign. Uploading final quote: "We moved to Redwood Dedicated and saw a ~25% faster 99th percentile latency and a meaningful reduction in inference spend. 1: Jonas Weber, Head of ML Ops, Triad Systems."
Ravi (Legal): Language approved. No PII. :thumbsup:
Lina (Marketing): Great. Please confirm when assets are uploaded. We'll run a final review 2026-06-02 07:00Z.
Marco (Growth): Confirmed.
Tess (CS): I'll monitor customer channel during publish.
Ravi (Legal): I'll stand by for last-minute checks.
Lina (Marketing): Closing thread 1: post back with asset links and SFDC finalization. :rocket:
